sources.shortCitation: Det Kgl. Bibliotek, Thorsing A. Th. 318 — “Ninon… smil engang endnu” (Danish, Ahl-Nielsen), cop. 1933
sources.fullCitation: Ninon… smil engang endnu: fra Fotorama-filmen “En Sang for Dig”. Musik: Walter Jurmann og B. Kaper; dansk tekst: Ahl-Nielsen; tysk tekst: Ernst Marischka og Fritz Rotter. København: Alfred Thorsing, cop. 1933. Plate A. Th. 318. 3 pp., piano with words. Det Kgl. Bibliotek, record alma99122931551505763.
sources.title: Ninon… smil engang endnu — Alfred Thorsing, A. Th. 318 (cop. 1933)
sources.researchNote: “En Sang for Dig” is the Danish title of Ein Lied für Dich. The Odeon disc D 609 by Bunds Danseorkester, with Valdemar Davids, gives the original title as “Ninon, lach mir einmal zu” (alma99122333533805763); Erik Tuxen’s orchestra recorded the song for Polyphon (X.S 50292) in 1933.
sources.creator: Det Kgl. Bibliotek (Royal Danish Library)

sources.fullCitation: Ninon…: smil engang endnu, “En Sang for Dig” / Ahl-Nielsen, B. Kaper & Walter Jurmann; Marius Jacobsen with Warny’s Orkester. HMV X. 4197, 78 rpm, recorded 1933. Det Kgl. Bibliotek, record alma99122186275805763.
sources.title: Ninon… smil engang endnu — HMV X. 4197 (1933)
sources.researchNote: The other side is “Sig har Du glemt” by Sigfred Pedersen and Erik Fiehn.
sources.creator: Det Kgl. Bibliotek (Royal Danish Library)

sources.shortCitation: Det Kgl. Bibliotek, Thorsing A. Th. 326 — “Oh Madonna” (Danish and Swedish), cop. 1933
sources.fullCitation: Oh Madonna: fra filmen “En Sang for Dig”. Musik: Jurmann og Kaper; dansk tekst: Giovanni Di Sorrento; svensk text: Per Silja; tysk tekst: Ernst Marischka og Fritz Rotter = Signorina. København: Alfred Thorsing, cop. 1933. Plate A. Th. 326. 3 pp., piano with words. Det Kgl. Bibliotek, record alma99122931567405763.
sources.title: Oh Madonna — Alfred Thorsing, A. Th. 326 (cop. 1933)
sources.researchNote: A second copy, for voice and piano, is described as from “En sång till dig”, the Swedish title of the film (alma99122825649805763). The German text is given as “Signorina”, the printed title of the German song.
sources.creator: Det Kgl. Bibliotek (Royal Danish Library)
